body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Misung Polytech(www.mspt.co.kr) introduced 'Tactile Sensor' which can control cursor using the position or power at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
'Tactile Sensor' made of flexible film is attachable at various curve goods and maximizes errors by recognizing the position.
'Tactile Sensor' will be useful for a variety type of design mouse, high-tech mobile device, Tablet PC, Joy Stick and keypad etc.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
